traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets imagination. Idealism and vision on a large scale. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Gullibility and wishful thinking mistaken for reality. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Growth and imagination reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Inspired vision; test it against logic before committing.
shadow: Excess and overreach collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
base: The more appealing a possibility becomes, the easier it is for hope to start doing work the evidence has not done yet.

readerCopy.body: The more appealing a possibility becomes, the easier it is for hope to start doing work the evidence has not done yet. When Jupiter opposes Neptune, confidence and ambiguity pull against each other, making a promise, cause, or opportunity feel increasingly meaningful while key facts remain difficult to pin down. Belief can coexist with scrutiny. Missing answers become especially important when more money, time, or trust is being requested to keep the vision alive.
